description: Estimate supported building costs, compare supplied builder quotes, review omissions and organise renovation budgets, scopes and changes.

interface.longDescription:
Estimate building and renovation costs from what you know, then refine the price with size, location, scope and readable plans.

Uses country-specific benchmarks in local currency for supported work in the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Germany, France, Spain, Canada, Japan and India. Available work types vary by country. Unsupported work is identified rather than priced as if supported.

Compare Budget, Standard, Premium and Luxury in the interactive card. Use metric or imperial measurements; Japanese inputs also support tatami and tsubo. See the price breakdown and add optional details without starting again.

When you attach readable drawings in ChatGPT, ChatGPT reads them and Proper Job calculates from the extracted quantities and scope. The calculator does not use a paid Proper Job drawing-extraction service or access your saved Proper Job jobs. ChatGPT account and attachment limits still apply.

Prices are budget estimates, not quotes or professional advice. Check the stated assumptions, exclusions and applicable local requirements before committing to work.

Additional workflows compare supplied builder quotes, check missing costs, organise several jobs, explore supported budget options, scope small jobs, prepare draft work schedules from a brief or drawings, reconcile whole-project budgets and review proposed extras. These workflows do not add unsupported trade rates. Supplied amounts stay distinct from calculator estimates; unknown costs and overlapping work remain visible.

Reply language, project country, currency, tax basis and measurement units remain separate. Quote and scope reviews can use supplied information even where local calculator pricing is unavailable. The host can explain results in your conversation language; available card translations vary.
defaultPrompt: Estimate a 30 m² rear extension in Bristol BS3, Standard finish, living space only.
Estimate a 500 sq ft backyard studio in Texas, Standard finish, with a bathroom.
Estimate a Tokyo condo renovation with a new kitchen, flooring and six replacement tatami mats.

positive.description: UK core price and direct finish comparison. No login required.
positive.prompt: Estimate a 30 m² rear extension in Bristol BS3, Standard finish. Detached 1990s house, normal access, ordinary ground, living space only, no new kitchen or bathroom.
positive.expected_behavior: Country GB, scope area 30 m², BS3 and Standard. One result card in this response, GBP range consistent with tool output, tax shown and breakdown available. Budget/Premium/Luxury update this card directly with distinct ranges, without another chat question.

positive.description: Sparse request: show an explicitly labelled reference or rough estimate first.
positive.prompt: How much might a rear extension in Bristol BS3 cost? I do not know the size yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the supported reference/rough result with its assumed area clearly identified; ask at most one useful optional question after showing the price. Do not present an assumed 30 m² as a user-supplied measurement.

positive.description: US imperial studio with local scope and USD pricing.
positive.prompt: Estimate a 500 sq ft backyard studio in Texas, Standard finish, with one bathroom, no kitchen, normal site access and ordinary ground.
positive.expected_behavior: Country US, Texas, backyard studio, 500 square feet. USD range and local tax treatment from the returned policy; preserve bathroom and no-kitchen facts. No UK postcode or UK property assumptions.

positive.description: Australia bathroom scope: local currency and appropriate work.
positive.prompt: Estimate a 6 m² bathroom renovation in Melbourne, Victoria, Standard finish. Replace the shower, toilet, basin, tiles and waterproofing; keep the existing layout.
positive.expected_behavior: Country AU and bathroom work, 6 m², Victoria and Standard; AUD range with the scope and tax basis returned by the calculator. Do not price an extension or withhold a result until every detail is supplied.

positive.prompt: Estimate a Tokyo condo renovation: 12 tatami of floor area, six new tatami mats, a western galley kitchen, wallpaper, 12 m² of wood flooring, one balcony-mounted air conditioner and one pendant at existing wiring. Built in 2006, twelfth floor with lift protection, Standard finish. Reply in Japanese.
positive.expected_behavior: Country JP, apartment/condo renovation, area unit tatami and explicitly six replacement mats. Preserve supplied work quantities and access facts; return JPY, Japanese card text and a breakdown. Do not turn floor area into a count of replacement mats or add whole-building earthquake work as a confirmed scope item.

negative.prompt: Find and delete the building quotes saved in my Proper Job account.

prompts: Compare ces devis pour les mêmes travaux à Lyon : Q1 1 250,00 € TTC, Q2 1 500,00 € TTC. Les deux comprennent fourniture et pose. Réponds en français et ne recalcule pas avec un barème.

Au Québec, mon devis de rénovation est de 80 000 $ CA, taxes comprises. Il exclut les honoraires et l'aménagement extérieur. Je ne sais pas si les raccordements sont inclus. Quels coûts manque-t-il ? Réponds en français.
भारत में घर की मरम्मत का ₹10 लाख का कोटेशन है। इसमें ₹2 लाख की रसोई और दोनों बाथरूम शामिल हैं। आँगन के लिए अलग ₹50,000 है। सभी रकम में टैक्स शामिल है और काम अलग हैं। कुल ज्ञात बजट बताइए।

Mi obra está en Texas. Tengo un presupuesto de 60.000 USD para construcción, impuestos incluidos. Los resultados comparables ya calculados son 55.000–75.000 USD y una opción menor de 48.000–65.000 USD, con la misma base fiscal. Explícalos en español sin recalcular.
日本の庭のフェンス15mを交換したいです。見積書も単価もありません。工事項目と、費用を出すために必要な情報を日本語で整理してください。

Erstelle auf Deutsch eine vorläufige Leistungsbeschreibung für meine Wohnung in Berlin: Küchenschränke bleiben, Arbeitsplatte erneuern, Wände streichen. Es gibt noch keine Zeichnungen. Keine Preise und keine rechtliche Bescheinigung.

For my Sydney project, the A$80,000 building quote includes GST and a A$20,000 kitchen. Separate fees are A$5,000 including GST. I choose an extra 10% contingency on construction only; none is included already. What is the known subtotal?

En mi reforma de Madrid, el precio original de 20.000 € incluye una provisión de 2.000 € para la cocina. La cocina de 3.000 € sustituye esa provisión. Todo tiene el mismo alcance y la misma base de IVA. ¿Cuál es el cambio neto?

publication.release_notes: Adds eight cost workflows: compare builder quotes, check missing costs, organise multiple jobs, explore budget options, scope small jobs, prepare drawing work schedules, reconcile project budgets and review building changes. Preserves supported country pricing and the existing calculator connection. Unsupported work and unknown costs remain visible; no new trade-rate coverage is claimed.

fr.subtitle: Calculateur de coûts travaux
fr.description:
Estimez le coût de travaux avec les informations disponibles, puis affinez avec les dimensions, le lieu, les travaux et des plans lisibles. Comparez les niveaux Budget, Standard, Premium et Luxe et consultez la ventilation du prix. Les travaux pris en charge varient selon le pays. Les prix sont des estimations budgétaires, pas des devis.

Vous pouvez aussi comparer des devis fournis, repérer des coûts manquants, organiser plusieurs travaux et examiner les modifications. La langue de réponse ne change ni le pays, ni la devise, ni les bases fiscales ou les unités du projet.

de.subtitle: Baukostenrechner
de.description:
Schätzen Sie Baukosten anhand der vorhandenen Angaben. Ergänzen Sie Größe, Ort, Umfang und lesbare Pläne. Vergleichen Sie Budget, Standard, Premium und Luxus und sehen Sie die Kostenaufteilung. Unterstützte Arbeiten unterscheiden sich je nach Land; in Deutschland ist der Neubau eines Hauses verfügbar. Die Preise sind Budgetschätzungen, keine Angebote.

Sie können auch vorliegende Bauangebote vergleichen, fehlende Kosten erkennen, mehrere Arbeiten budgetieren und Änderungen prüfen. Die Antwortsprache ändert weder Projektland und Währung noch Steuerbasis oder Maßeinheiten.

es.subtitle: Calculadora de costes de obra
es.description:
Estime el coste de las obras con los datos disponibles y afínelo con medidas, ubicación, alcance y planos legibles. Compare Económico, Estándar, Premium y Lujo y consulte el desglose. Las obras disponibles varían según el país. Los precios son estimaciones presupuestarias, no presupuestos de contratistas.

También puede comparar presupuestos aportados, detectar costes pendientes, organizar varias obras y revisar cambios. El idioma de la respuesta no cambia el país, la moneda, la base fiscal ni las unidades del proyecto.

ja.subtitle: 建築・リフォーム費用計算
ja.description:
分かっている情報から建築・リフォーム費用を概算し、面積、場所、工事内容、読み取れる図面で条件を詳しくできます。費用内訳を確認し、予算重視・標準・プレミアム・ラグジュアリーを比較できます。日本では畳・坪での面積入力にも対応します。対応する工事は国によって異なります。表示価格は概算予算であり、業者の見積書や専門家の助言ではありません。

提示された見積書の比較、未計上費用の確認、複数工事の予算整理、変更内容の確認にも対応します。回答の言語を変えても、工事対象国・通貨・税の前提・測定単位は変わりません。

hi.subtitle: निर्माण लागत कैलकुलेटर
hi.description:
उपलब्ध जानकारी से निर्माण या नवीनीकरण की लागत का अनुमान लगाएँ। आकार, स्थान, काम और पढ़ने योग्य नक्शे जोड़कर अनुमान सुधारें। बजट, स्टैंडर्ड, प्रीमियम और लक्ज़री की तुलना करें और लागत का विवरण देखें। उपलब्ध काम देश के अनुसार अलग हैं। कीमतें बजट अनुमान हैं, ठेकेदार के कोटेशन या पेशेवर सलाह नहीं।

दिए गए ठेकेदारों के कोटेशन की तुलना करें, छूटे हुए खर्च पहचानें, कई कामों का बजट व्यवस्थित करें और बदलावों की समीक्षा करें। उत्तर की भाषा बदलने से परियोजना का देश, मुद्रा, कर का आधार या माप की इकाइयाँ नहीं बदलतीं।

it.subtitle: Calcolatore dei costi edili
it.description:
Stima i costi di costruzione e ristrutturazione con le informazioni disponibili, poi aggiungi dimensioni, luogo, lavori e disegni leggibili. Confronta Budget, Standard, Premium e Lusso e consulta la ripartizione dei costi. I lavori disponibili variano da paese a paese. I prezzi sono stime di budget, non preventivi o consulenza professionale.

È inoltre possibile confrontare preventivi forniti, individuare costi mancanti, organizzare più lavori ed esaminare le modifiche. La lingua della risposta non cambia paese, valuta, base fiscale o unità di misura del progetto.

pt.subtitle: Calculadora de custos de obra
pt.description:
Estime os custos de construção e renovação com as informações disponíveis e acrescente dimensões, local, trabalhos e plantas legíveis. Compare Econômico, Padrão, Premium e Luxo e consulte a composição do preço. Os trabalhos disponíveis variam por país. Os preços são estimativas de orçamento, não propostas de empreiteiros nem aconselhamento profissional.

Também é possível comparar orçamentos fornecidos, identificar custos em falta, organizar várias obras e analisar alterações. O idioma da resposta não muda o país, a moeda, a base tributária ou as unidades de medida do projeto.
